items.sql: SELECT SUM(mart_junior.vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE mart_junior.source = 'habr' AND mart_junior.role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT sum(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT telegram_posts FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'telegram' AND role_bucket = 'qa' LIMIT 1000
SELECT sum(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'data_engineering' LIMIT 1000
SELECT vacancies_active FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'habr' AND week = (SELECT max(week) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'habr') LIMIT 1000
SELECT vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'security' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) * 1.0) / SUM(vacancies) AS share, SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) AS hybrid_vacancies, SUM(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'backend' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS total_vacancies, SUM(vacancies) AS office_vacancies, SUM(vacancies) / SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS share FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source = 'habr' AND work_format = 'office' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) - SUM(vacancies)) / SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS share, SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS total_vacancies, SUM(vacancies) AS vacancies_with_format FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'other_it' AND work_format = 'unknown' LIMIT 1000

SELECT role_bucket, (CAST(vacancies_remote AS Float64) / CAST(vacancies_in_bucket AS Float64)) AS share, vacancies_in_bucket FROM (SELECT role_bucket, SUM(vacancies) AS vacancies_in_bucket, SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'remote' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) AS vacancies_remote FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source = 'habr' GROUP BY role_bucket HAVING SUM(vacancies) >= 30) ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (with_salary_rub / vacancies) AS share, with_salary_rub, vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(mart_junior.vacancies) - SUM(mart_junior.open_to_junior)) / SUM(mart_junior.vacancies) AS share, SUM(mart_junior.vacancies) AS total_vacancies, SUM(mart_junior.open_to_junior) AS junior_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE role_bucket = 'ml_ds' AND source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT salary_from_median FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'backend' AND grade = 'senior' AND region_group = 'remote' LIMIT 1000

SELECT salary_from_p25 AS p25, salary_from_p75 AS p75 FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' AND grade = 'unknown' AND region_group = 'moscow' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(mart_salaries.with_salary_rub) AS rub_salary_count FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE mart_salaries.source = 'trudvsem' AND mart_salaries.role_bucket = 'backend' AND mart_salaries.vacancies > 0 LIMIT 1000

SELECT region_group, salary_from_median FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'data_analytics' AND grade = 'unknown' AND region_group IN ('moscow', 'spb') ORDER BY region_group LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, grade, salary_from_median FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'habr' AND region_group = 'remote' AND NOT (salary_from_median IS NULL) LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(salary_from_median) / SUM(vacancies)) AS median_salary_from, SUM(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE role_bucket = 'sysadmin_support' AND grade = 'unknown' AND source = 'trudvsem' AND region_group = 'moscow' OR region_group = 'spb' OR region_group = 'other' LIMIT 1000
SELECT skill, SUM(vacancies_mentioning) AS total_mentions FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' GROUP BY skill ORDER BY total_mentions DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT (SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) * 1.0 / SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_in_cell)) AS share, SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) AS numerator, SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_in_cell) AS denominator FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'telegram' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' AND skill = 'LLM' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT skill) AS unique_skills_count FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) * 1.0 / SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_in_cell)) AS share, SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) AS numerator, SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_in_cell) AS denominator FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'backend' AND skill = 'Docker' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(mart_skills.vacancies_mentioning) AS total_junior_vacancies_with_sql FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills JOIN agent_snapshot.mart_junior ON mart_skills.source = mart_junior.source AND mart_skills.role_bucket = mart_junior.role_bucket AND mart_skills.grade = 'junior' WHERE mart_skills.skill = 'SQL' AND mart_skills.source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(vacancies_mentioning) AS total_kubernetes_mentions FROM agent_snapshot.mart_skills WHERE source = 'telegram' AND skill = 'Kubernetes' LIMIT 1000
SELECT vacancies_new FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE week = '2026-08-10' AND source = 'trudvsem_snapshot' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT week, vacancies_new FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'trudvsem_snapshot' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' AND NOT (vacancies_new IS NULL) ORDER BY vacancies_new DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT telegram_channels FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE week = '2026-09-21' AND source = 'telegram' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT week, telegram_posts AS unique_posts FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'telegram' AND week BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' ORDER BY telegram_posts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(vacancies_new) AS new_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'trudvsem_snapshot' AND week >= '2026-07-01' AND week < '2026-08-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_weekly_dynamics WHERE source = 'trudvsem_snapshot' LIMIT 1000
SELECT SUM(open_to_junior) AS open_junior_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, SUM(open_to_junior) AS total_junior_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'trudvsem' GROUP BY role_bucket ORDER BY total_junior_vacancies DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT role_bucket, (open_to_junior * 1.0 / vacancies) AS share FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT source, SUM(open_to_junior) AS total_junior_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE role_bucket = 'ml_ds' GROUP BY source ORDER BY source LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(no_experience_required) + SUM(graded_intern) + SUM(graded_junior) AS total_with_experience_filled FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' LIMIT 1000
SELECT sum(graded_intern) AS total_internships FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' AND role_bucket = 'software_engineer' LIMIT 1000
SELECT employer_name, open_it_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' ORDER BY open_it_vacancies DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT it_vacancies_seen FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Сбербанк%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT employer_rank, employer_name FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'habr' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Cloud.ru%' LIMIT 1000

SELECT (SUM(mart_employers.open_it_vacancies) * 1.0) / SUM(mart_employers.it_vacancies_seen) AS share, SUM(mart_employers.open_it_vacancies) AS open_vacancies, SUM(mart_employers.it_vacancies_seen) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Сбербанк%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
SELECT lifetime_median_days FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_name ILIKE '%Гринатом%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND NOT (lifetime_median_days IS NULL) AND lifetime_median_days > 30 LIMIT 1000
SELECT MAX(lifetime_median_days) AS max_median_lifetime FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT employer_key) FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'habr' AND NOT (lifetime_median_days IS NULL) LIMIT 1000
SELECT lifetime_median_days FROM agent_snapshot.mart_employers WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND employer_rank = 3 LIMIT 1000

SELECT source AS label, SUM(vacancies) / SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS share, SUM(vacancies_in_bucket) AS total, SUM(vacancies) AS remote FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE role_bucket = 'ml_ds' AND source IN ('habr', 'telegram', 'trudvsem') AND work_format = 'remote' GROUP BY source LIMIT 1000

SELECT work_format, sumIf(vacancies, source = 'trudvsem') AS trudvsem_vacancies, sumIf(vacancies, source = 'habr') AS habr_vacancies, sumIf(vacancies, source = 'telegram') AS telegram_vacancies, sum(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE source IN ('trudvsem', 'habr', 'telegram') GROUP BY work_format ORDER BY total_vacancies DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'telegram' AND NOT (role_bucket IN ('multi_post')) ORDER BY vacancies DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT grade, SUM(vacancies) AS total_vacancies FROM agent_snapshot.mart_salaries WHERE source = 'trudvsem' AND role_bucket = 'ml_ds' GROUP BY grade ORDER BY grade LIMIT 1000

SELECT source, SUM(vacancies) AS total_vacancies, SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) AS hybrid_vacancies, SUM(CASE WHEN work_format = 'hybrid' THEN vacancies ELSE 0 END) / SUM(vacancies) AS hybrid_share FROM agent_snapshot.mart_work_format WHERE role_bucket = 'backend' AND source IN ('habr', 'telegram', 'trudvsem') GROUP BY source ORDER BY source LIMIT 1000
SELECT role_bucket, open_to_junior FROM agent_snapshot.mart_junior WHERE source = 'habr' LIMIT 1000
